text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Even if the wheels come off— Nobody 
can stop my momentum!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! How is it, how is it, 
Gim-senpai?! I tried to come up with 
something that feels totally like you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! From your incantation, I could 
see... a pitch-black Qilin galloping 
across the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“A lie? Far from it. In fact, such ash 
tree-like growth speed—as your 
predecessor, I am truly proud.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoaaaa...! I-In that case! Well, not 
'in that case', but um! Actually, my races 
have been going pretty well lately too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to see it too, Senpai! If you 
don't mind, would you run alongside me for 
just a bit?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Very well. Show me that you can 
tear off both my wings!

I had just finished all of today's 
training, but—
choice_data_list: Let's just call it quits for today

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come—forward, youth who defies fate! 
Ignite the twilight! Let the battle 
commence!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright! You'd better come at me with 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Of course! I believe I understand 
your true strength better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! R-Right, of course! You just finished 
training, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I can't push you too hard, Senpai! So, if 
it's okay, let's do it again tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Very well, I shall not brush your 
sentiments aside. Until tomorrow, young 
one who defies fate.
